description:
Hi,
 This is Anthony from Infojini Consulting. Hope you are doing well! 
 We are Looking for Drupal Web Developer position based in Columbia, MD 12+ months contract position. Please send your resume along with hourly rate expectation to anthony(dot)v@infojiniconsulting(dot)com  ASAP or call me at 443-270-1551.Please refer someone else if you are not available at this time or you are not the right match for this job opportunity. We have great Referral Bonus up to $1000!!! Please don't miss to refer someone who is looking for projects. 
 JOB DETAILS GIVEN BELOW:-
 Title: Drupal Web Developer
 Duration: Full-time
 Location: Columbia, MD(locals only)

 Required Skills:
 * Create and extend Drupal themes/sub-themes using mobile-first and responsive design practices
 * Configure new and existing Drupal sites using core, contributed, and custom modules
 * Develop custom modules to facilitate integration with existing systems and services
 * Integrate internal or third party products into Drupal sites
 * Integrate commenting, rating, posting, and other social media networking features into Drupal sites
 * Migrate content from existing websites into Drupal
 * Perform site testing and issue resolution
 * Perform core and module updates
 * Provide training and guidance to new Drupal users
 * Support and troubleshoot with existing users in-person and remotely
 * Manage and process support tickets to ensure timely resolution of issues
 * Manage website code repositories, and maintain code branches
 Technical & Programming Language Skills:
 * Drupal 7 (module development/configuration, back-end development)
 * Drupal modules (including Panels, Display Suite, Views, Context)
 * PHP
 * Javascript
 * HTML
 * MySQL
 * Git Repository (commit, merge, migrate)
 * CSS
 * Linux CLI

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
